releases.name: PlanWeft 0.7.1-node.1
releases.body:
Documentation-completion prerelease for the PlanWeft Node runtime migration. The bilingual installation guides now give complete-install, removal, and Skill-only file effects for all 15 targets. READMEs and architecture guides distinguish user, tool, model, and script responsibilities and show CSV failure retries plus separate explicit execute/loop flows.

Install from npm with `npm install planweft@next`; `latest` remains 0.7.0. Managed installs pin a verified absolute Node path and require Node >=22.13.0. Hermes remains Skill-only. Validation used static official-adapter review, generated-package checks, and script tests on Linux, macOS, and Windows; no local Agent clients were launched or claimed as verified.

releases.name: PlanWeft 0.7.1-node.0
releases.body:
PlanWeft Node runtime migration prerelease. Install from npm with `npm install planweft@next`; the `latest` tag remains at 0.7.0.

Supported shipped daily paths now use packaged Node entrypoints, including the five primary integrations, experimental Hooks, and standalone Skills for 15 targets. Managed installations pin a verified absolute Node path. The minimum supported Node version is 22.13.0. Hermes remains Skill-only; its historical full Python runtime is not supported.

The historical 0.4.0 five-Agent test archive and runner were removed. Validation used script and package tests plus review of official adaptation contracts; no local Agent clients were launched. Real-client behavior is not claimed as tested.

releases.name: PlanWeft 0.7.0
releases.body: PlanWeft 0.7.0: P1 deterministic state checkpoints and Artifact reducer. Real Agent/model sessions, tokens/cost, and real cross-Agent continuation remain Not Run.

releases.name: PlanWeft v0.6.0
releases.body:
PlanWeft v0.6.0 — deterministic P0 task-state evidence store.

Highlights
- Adds .planweft-state/ task-side state, artifact receipts, integrity verification, recall, doctor, and explicit recovery.
- Generates state assets across supported host packages and the Codex mirror.
- Publishes reproducible offline evidence and public documentation for the P0 boundary.

Validation
- Candidate workflow 35242327786 passed build, installer checks, and 362 offline Python tests.
- npm candidate was published to next and registry tarball SHA-256 is 7e913d3c43e852aaf59dbb2fc7adb3b7aa275453cf3041ec1acdebea80be9c5e.
- Real Agent/model regression and tokens/cost remain Not Run by explicit scope.

Source: master commit 5c23fa3686ca7666b227c6f8cc691f864d0d5921.

releases.name: PlanWeft 0.5.1
releases.body:
## PlanWeft 0.5.1

- Adds the optional, human-readable Documentation Map for existing documentation indexes.
- Keeps project-docs Skill-first document handoff and Hook-only handoff-state reminders.
- Publishes the verified `planweft@0.5.1` archive to npm `latest` and `next`.

The release tag points to the verified master release record. See the repository documentation for release evidence and validation scope.
